nom: Cell Fusion C Laser UV Defense Sunscreen SPF 50

avis.texte: I purchased several different sunscreens to find the best for me. This smells like sunscreen which is not a big deal or shocking. The white cast is unmistakable and takes a while to absorb even while rubbing it in. The pilling is irritating. I would not purchase this again, I would return it if that were an option. It will be an arm/hand sunscreen, but suitable for face.

avis.titre: I've been waiting for Ulta Beauty to carry this product!
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin that usually reacts to most sunscreens, but this one is amazing. It goes on super smoothly and doesn't leave any white cast, which is a huge plus for me. My skin actually feels more hydrated and calm after applying it. It's lightweight enough to wear under makeup and gives a nice natural glow. This has become my daily sunscreen!
